checklist.text: Stock is free of checks, wind, and loose knots

steps.title: Select Hard maple for A1, A2
steps.instruction: Pull the rough boards for these parts and check each one for checks, wind, and loose knots. Keep the best faces for the parts that show them.

checklist.text: Stock is free of checks, wind, and loose knots

steps.title: Select Hard maple for A3, A4
steps.instruction: Pull the rough boards for these parts and check each one for checks, wind, and loose knots. Keep the best faces for the parts that show them.

checklist.text: Stock is free of checks, wind, and loose knots

steps.title: Select Hard maple for L1, L2, L3, L4
steps.instruction: Pull the rough boards for these parts and check each one for checks, wind, and loose knots. Keep the best faces for the parts that show them.

checklist.text: Stock is free of checks, wind, and loose knots

steps.title: Select Walnut for T
steps.instruction: Pull the rough boards for this edge-glued panel and check each one for checks, wind, and loose knots. Choose boards whose grain and color match across the panel.

steps.title: Rip the boards for the top
steps.instruction: Joint one edge of each board, then rip every board to the same width at one fence setting, keeping the best edges for the glue joints.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap on a dry clamp

steps.title: Glue up the top
steps.instruction: Arrange the boards for the best grain match, spread glue on each joint, and clamp evenly with the faces flush.

steps.title: Let the top glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the panel clamped until the glue has set.

steps.title: Flatten the top
steps.instruction: Remove the glue squeeze-out and flatten both faces to the milled thickness.

checklist.text: Reference face is flat before planing

steps.title: Mill the Hard maple to thickness
steps.instruction: Joint one face and one edge of each board, then plane every board to the same milled thickness.

checklist.text: Reference face is flat before planing

steps.title: Mill the Hard maple to thickness
steps.instruction: Joint one face and one edge of each board, then plane every board to the same milled thickness.

steps.title: Rip parts to width
steps.instruction: Rip A1, A2, A3, A4 at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Rip parts to width
steps.instruction: Rip L1, L2, L3, L4 at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Rip parts to width
steps.instruction: Rip T at one fence setting, with the jointed edge against the fence.

steps.title: Crosscut parts to length
steps.instruction: Crosscut A1, A2 against a stop block at one setting so every piece matches.

steps.title: Crosscut parts to length
steps.instruction: Crosscut A3, A4 against a stop block at one setting so every piece matches.

steps.title: Crosscut parts to length
steps.instruction: Crosscut L1, L2, L3, L4 against a stop block at one setting so every piece matches.

steps.title: Crosscut parts to length
steps.instruction: Crosscut T against a stop block at one setting so every piece matches.

checklist.text: Write A1 on the Front apron; keep the front face clean
Write A2 on the Back apron; keep the back face clean
Write A3 on the Left apron; keep the left face clean
Write A4 on the Right apron; keep the right face clean
Write L1 on the Front left leg; keep the front, back, left, right faces clean
Write L2 on the Front right leg; keep the front, back, left, right faces clean
Write L3 on the Back left leg; keep the front, back, left, right faces clean
Write L4 on the Back right leg; keep the front, back, left, right faces clean
Write T on the Top; keep the top, front, back, left, right faces clean

steps.title: Mark every part
steps.instruction: Write each part mark on its reference face, and note which faces show on the finished piece so the best faces end up there.

checklist.text: A test cut on scrap fits the mating part
Cut tenons on the Front apron (mt-front-fl)
Cut tenons on the Front apron (mt-front-fr)
Cut tenons on the Back apron (mt-back-bl)
Cut tenons on the Back apron (mt-back-br)
Cut tenons on the Left apron (mt-left-fl)
Cut tenons on the Left apron (mt-left-bl)
Cut tenons on the Right apron (mt-right-fr)
Cut tenons on the Right apron (mt-right-br)

steps.title: Cut the tenons
steps.instruction: Set up the table saw from the setup values. Test the setup on scrap and check the fit, then cut each marked part.

checklist.text: A test cut on scrap fits the mating part
Cut mortises on the Front left leg (mt-front-fl)
Cut mortises on the Front right leg (mt-front-fr)
Cut mortises on the Back left leg (mt-back-bl)
Cut mortises on the Back right leg (mt-back-br)
Cut mortises on the Front left leg (mt-left-fl)
Cut mortises on the Back left leg (mt-left-bl)
Cut mortises on the Front right leg (mt-right-fr)
Cut mortises on the Back right leg (mt-right-br)

steps.title: Cut the mortises
steps.instruction: Set up the mortiser from the setup values. Test the setup on scrap and check the fit, then cut each marked part.

checklist.text: A test cut on scrap fits the mating part
Cut fastener slots on the Front apron (tf-front)
Cut fastener slots on the Back apron (tf-back)
Cut fastener slots on the Left apron (tf-left)
Cut fastener slots on the Right apron (tf-right)

steps.title: Cut the fastener slots
steps.instruction: Set up the router from the setup values. Test the setup on scrap and check the fit, then cut each marked part.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap
The unit sits square and flat

steps.title: Dry fit the front leg frame
steps.instruction: Fit the parts together without glue, check that every joint closes and the unit is square, then take it apart and keep the parts in order.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap
The unit sits square and flat

steps.title: Dry fit the back leg frame
steps.instruction: Fit the parts together without glue, check that every joint closes and the unit is square, then take it apart and keep the parts in order.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap
The unit sits square and flat

steps.title: Dry fit the base
steps.instruction: Fit the parts together without glue, check that every joint closes and the unit is square, then take it apart and keep the parts in order.

checklist.text: Every joint closes with no gap
The unit sits square and flat

steps.title: Dry fit the whole piece
steps.instruction: Fit every assembly and loose part together without glue to confirm the whole piece goes together, then take it apart.

checklist.text: Joint surfaces and tenon cheeks stay unsanded so the fits stay tight

steps.title: Sand the inside faces
steps.instruction: Sand the faces that will be hard to reach once the parts are glued, working through the grits and keeping paper off the joint surfaces.

checklist.text: The dry fit closed cleanly
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Front apron to Front left leg
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Front apron to Front right leg

steps.title: Glue and clamp the front leg frame
steps.instruction: Spread glue on the joints, bring the parts together in the dry-fit order, and clamp evenly, checking the unit stays square.

steps.title: Let the front leg frame glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the assembly clamped until the glue has set.

checklist.text: The dry fit closed cleanly
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Back apron to Back left leg
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Back apron to Back right leg

steps.title: Glue and clamp the back leg frame
steps.instruction: Spread glue on the joints, bring the parts together in the dry-fit order, and clamp evenly, checking the unit stays square.

steps.title: Let the back leg frame glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the assembly clamped until the glue has set.

checklist.text: The dry fit closed cleanly
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Left apron to Front left leg
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Left apron to Back left leg
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Right apron to Front right leg
Close the mortise and tenon joint: Right apron to Back right leg
Both diagonals measure the same before the glue sets

steps.title: Glue and clamp the base
steps.instruction: Spread glue on the joints, bring the parts together in the dry-fit order, and clamp evenly, checking the unit stays square.

steps.title: Let the base glue set
steps.instruction: Leave the assembly clamped until the glue has set.

checklist.text: Close the tabletop fastener joint: Top to Front apron
Close the tabletop fastener joint: Top to Back apron
Close the tabletop fastener joint: Top to Left apron
Close the tabletop fastener joint: Top to Right apron

steps.title: Fasten the whole piece
steps.instruction: Join the parts with the listed fasteners, leaving room for the top to move with the seasons where it is fastened.

steps.title: Apply the finish
steps.instruction: Do the final sanding through the grits, remove the dust, and apply the finish in thin coats.

steps.title: Let the finish dry
steps.instruction: Leave the piece undisturbed until the finish has dried hard enough to handle.
